as_told.title: Chase Brandon's novel: committee with a crystal tablet showing future timelines

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, speaking with the author Peter Levenda, describes something called the Kryptos Conundrum: a secret US intelligence committee said to manage the course of human history. Michels says that non-human beings appear to each committee member separately, in a paranormal way, and coordinate them, and he links the story to Chase Brandon, a former CIA officer. If true, it would mean outside beings are quietly steering human events through government insiders.
